notes.en: Aimed for a cleanly proportioned Vitruvian Man whose dual-pose overlay reads at every size, with tiered engraving detail that scales from a solid gold silhouette at navbar size to cross-hatched anatomical study at large. Shaped the head with a narrowing jaw to avoid the smiley-face trap, and used knuckle curves instead of finger-separation lines to keep hands from reading as forks. Still weak: hands and feet are paddle shapes rather than articulated, the raised arms lack naturalistic muscle variation, and the engraving could carry more varied hatching patterns.
